digest.component_or_area: contributor documentation and contributor workflow guidance
propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific maintainer bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of directing contributors to use their own configured git identity.
Multiple documentation files (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) contain contradictory or inconsistent DCO sign-off instructions regarding identity and authorship.
A deterministic lint check must be implemented to prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off identities in contributor-facing documentation files.
Automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/, docs/experiments/) legitimately reference the bot identity and must be excluded from the consistency sweep.
